description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelEditButton class, which extends SugarWidgetField. It provides methods for rendering header cells and list entries for a subpanel edit button in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface, including generating the HTML for the edit link with JavaScript event handlers.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEditButton
classes.description: A widget class used to generate the SubPanel Edit Button link in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, handling display logic for editing related records.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns an empty string; the header cell for this widget is intentionally left blank.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML anchor tag for the edit button in a subpanel row, including JavaScript handlers for editing a related record.
